scripts.build: node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply verdi-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply verdi-db --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute verdi-db --local --file=./seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/generate-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute verdi-db --remote --file=./seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:test: node scripts/check-migrations.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply verdi-db-test --remote --env test
